title: Oxlint Lint Target
description: Lints a project with Oxlint. Runs in batch mode by default, so one Oxlint process lints every project in the run, from the workspace root. Options not listed here are forwarded to Oxlint as CLI flags; paths in them are relative to the workspace root.

lintFilePatterns.description: One or more files or directories to pass to Oxlint. Oxlint does not expand globs.

nestedProjectRoots.description: Workspace-relative roots of projects nested inside this one. The inferred target sets this.

format.description: Output format. Rendered by Nx from the Oxlint JSON report, so only these values are supported. `default` matches the Oxlint terminal output, and switches to `agent` in CI or under an AI agent, as Oxlint does.

args.description: Extra arguments appended to the Oxlint command. A string is split on whitespace outside quotes, with no shell escaping or expansion; an array passes each item as one argument. Paths are relative to the workspace root, which is where Oxlint runs. In a batch, Oxlint uses the first project's arguments, so list extra paths in `lintFilePatterns` instead.
